$comment: Golden (query, expected-result) pairs over conformance/query/bundle mounted under alias `gold`. Every query is fully ORDER BY-ed so row order is part of the contract. Expected values are derived from the formulas in fixture.sql, not copied from an engine run. `requires` lists engine capabilities a case needs (see README.md).

cases.name: objects_count
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM gold.objects

cases.name: paths_dictionary
cases.$comment: `path_index >= 0` is the idiom that excludes the synthesized virtual path — the real dictionary is the non-negative half.
cases.sql: SELECT path_index, path FROM gold.paths WHERE path_index >= 0 AND path_index < 3 ORDER BY path_index

cases.name: paths_raw_is_the_unsynthesized_dictionary
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM gold.paths_raw

cases.name: virtual_application_id_path
cases.$comment: The mount synthesizes the applicationId path (this producer does not emit it): exactly one row, at the negative sentinel ordinal.
cases.sql: SELECT path_index, path FROM gold.paths WHERE path = 'applicationId' ORDER BY path_index

cases.name: paths_is_dictionary_plus_virtual
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE path_index >= 0) AS dictionary, count(*) FILTER (WHERE path_index < 0) AS virtual FROM gold.paths

cases.name: eav_row_count_spans_row_groups
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM gold.eav

cases.name: eav_filter_across_row_groups
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, min(object_index) AS lo, max(object_index) AS hi FROM gold.eav WHERE value_double > 15000

cases.name: eav_last_row_group_is_readable
cases.sql: SELECT object_index, path_index, value_double, internal_definition_name FROM gold.eav WHERE object_index = 199 AND path_index = 32

cases.name: boolean_values_round_trip
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_boolean) AS yes, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT value_boolean) AS no FROM gold.eav WHERE path_index = 4

cases.name: unit_bearing_double_sum
cases.sql: SELECT unit, round(sum(value_double), 2) AS total FROM gold.eav WHERE path_index IN (2, 3) GROUP BY unit ORDER BY unit

cases.name: category_breakdown_via_object_properties
cases.sql: SELECT p.value_string AS category, count(*) AS n FROM gold.object_properties p JOIN gold.paths d ON d.path_index = p.path_index WHERE d.path = 'category' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: object_properties_is_instance_union_type
cases.$comment: 6000 instance rows + 597 type-resolved rows + 200 virtual applicationId rows (one per object).
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM gold.object_properties

cases.name: application_id_reachable_as_a_property
cases.sql: SELECT p.object_index, p.value_string FROM gold.object_properties p JOIN gold.paths d ON d.path_index = p.path_index WHERE d.path = 'applicationId' AND p.object_index < 3 ORDER BY p.object_index

cases.name: application_id_arm_matches_the_objects_table
cases.$comment: The virtual arm is `objects` read through the property view: one row per object, value_string = application_id, no other column set.
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM gold.object_properties p JOIN gold.objects o ON o.object_index = p.object_index AND o.application_id = p.value_string WHERE p.path_index = -1 AND p.value_double IS NULL AND p.value_boolean IS NULL AND p.unit IS NULL AND p.internal_definition_name IS NULL

cases.name: type_params_resolve_through_object_type
cases.sql: SELECT d.path, p.value_string, p.value_double, p.unit FROM gold.object_properties p JOIN gold.paths d ON d.path_index = p.path_index WHERE p.object_index = 5 AND d.path IN ('Type Name', 'Fire Rating', 'Thickness') ORDER BY d.path

cases.name: untyped_object_has_instance_rows_only
cases.$comment: Object 199 has no object_type row, so it contributes its 30 instance rows plus the virtual applicationId row — and nothing from type_eav.
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE path_index >= 0) AS instance_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE path_index < 0) AS virtual_rows FROM gold.object_properties WHERE object_index = 199

cases.name: orphan_type_contributes_nothing
cases.sql: SELECT t.type_key, count(ot.object_index) AS objects FROM gold.types t LEFT JOIN gold.object_type ot ON ot.type_index = t.type_index GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: objects_per_level
cases.sql: SELECT n.name AS level, count(*) AS n FROM gold.relations r JOIN gold.nodes n ON n.id = r.dst WHERE r.rel = 7 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: levels_order_by_elevation
cases.sql: SELECT name, elevation FROM gold.nodes WHERE kind = 5 ORDER BY elevation

cases.name: instances_resolve_definitions
cases.sql: SELECT i.id AS instance, d.name AS definition, i.units FROM gold.nodes i JOIN gold.nodes d ON d.id = i.def_ref WHERE i.kind = 2 ORDER BY i.id

cases.name: container_subtype
cases.sql: SELECT name, subtype FROM gold.nodes WHERE kind = 7 ORDER BY id

cases.name: material_and_color_nodes
cases.sql: SELECT kind, name, argb, opacity, roughness FROM gold.nodes WHERE kind IN (3, 4) ORDER BY kind

cases.name: rel_types_catalog_names_relations
cases.sql: SELECT rt.name AS rel, count(*) AS n FROM gold.relations r JOIN gold.rel_types rt ON rt.id = r.rel GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: node_kinds_catalog_names_nodes
cases.sql: SELECT k.name AS kind, count(*) AS n FROM gold.nodes n JOIN gold.node_kinds k ON k.id = n.kind GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: meta_schema_version
cases.sql: SELECT schema_version, produced_by, sdk_name FROM gold.meta

cases.name: display_relations_reach_geometry_without_a_geometry_view
cases.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT dst) AS geometries, count(*) AS placements FROM gold.relations WHERE rel = 1

cases.name: scene_views
cases.sql: SELECT view, name, is_default, source, ref FROM gold.scene_views ORDER BY ord

cases.name: camera_views
cases.sql: SELECT name, is_default, is_ortho, fov, units, pos_x, pos_y, pos_z FROM gold.camera_views ORDER BY view

cases.name: structural_results
cases.sql: SELECT object_index, element_name, result_type, load_case, component, position_label, value FROM gold.structural_results ORDER BY result_type, component

cases.name: property_set_definitions
cases.sql: SELECT set_key, field_name, data_type, unit, applies_to FROM gold.property_set_definitions ORDER BY field_name

cases.name: model_scoped_eav
cases.sql: SELECT path, value_string, value_double FROM gold.model ORDER BY path

cases.name: local_csv_join
cases.sql: SELECT o.application_id, q.qty, q.supplier FROM gold.objects o JOIN read_csv('{{local_dir}}/quantities.csv') q ON q.application_id = o.application_id ORDER BY o.application_id
